summary: Test suite covers happy paths and core requirements well (manifest parsing, license classification, report generation, workflow structure) but has significant gaps in edge cases and error handling. Missing: malformed requirements.txt error cases, invalid config/db JSON via CLI, all missing CLI argument variations, requirements.txt through full act pipeline, special characters in package names, whitespace-only licenses, and error scenarios through act. Act tests verify exact output for 3 success cases but skip error paths entirely. Design is clear and modular with good fixtures; would catch basic regressions but miss boundary conditions and error handling regressions.
